Appraiser
The Appraiser’s Office discovers, inspects, evaluates, and values both real estate and taxable personal property in the county each year for ad valorem tax purposes.
Clerk's Office
Visit the County Clerk's office for records and election information.
County Attorney’s Office
Find Attorney's Office staff contacts and department information.
Economic Development
Discover Economic Development Department grants, staff directory, and online applications.
Emergency Management
Emergency Management coordinates disaster response and emergency planning.
Fire Department
Reach out to the Fire Department.
GIS / Mapping
The GIS / Mapping Department is responsible for providing accurate, detailed maps of various features and data sets in Linn County.
Health Department
Access public health programs and services.
Information Technology
The IT Department provides countywide IT support and manages servers, devices, and networks.
Linn County Park
Visit Linn County Park in LaCygne, KS.
Motor Vehicle
The Motor Vehicle Department offers license renewals, VIN inspections at partner sites, and driver's education.
Noxious Weeds
Information on various weeds, the Kansas Noxious Weed Control Program, and the Kansas Noxious Weed Law is available through the Kansas Department of Agriculture.
Nutrition
The ECKAAA Nutrition Program offers senior meals (dining and home-delivered) for ages 60 and older.
Planning & Zoning
Apply for building permits online; access zoning changes, CUPs, subdivisions, agendas, and planning information.
Register of Deeds Office
The Register of Deeds office is responsible for the filing of deeds and other documents, including mortgages, mortgage releases, oil and gas leases, plats, military discharge records, power of attorney, corporation records, cemetery records, and many other instruments.
Road & Bridge / Public Works
Please direct any questions, comments, or concerns to the Public Works front office in Mound City.
Sheriff’s Office
Visit the Linn County Sheriff’s Office.
Solid Waste
Gather information about the Solid Waste Department.
Transportation
Linn County General Public Transportation was established in 1979 and covers all of Linn County Kansas.
Treasurer’s Office
Pay taxes, protest payments, view taxes due, and access online payment options.
